mapper.sql: select tstockdetail.id, tstockdetail.location_id, tstockdetail.material_id, tstockdetail.before_count, tstockdetail.current_count, tstockdetail.type, tstockdetail.origin_id, tstockdetail.origin_code, tstockdetail.status, tstockdetail.create_by, tstockdetail.create_time, tstockdetail.update_by, tstockdetail.update_time, tstockdetail.remark, tstockdetail.dept_id, tstockdetail.dept_name, tstockdetail.del_flag from t_stock_detail tstockdetail
mapper.delete: update t_stock_detail set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_stock_detail set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select:
select tstockdetail.id, tstockdetail.location_id, tstockdetail.material_id, tstockdetail.before_count, tstockdetail.current_count, tstockdetail.type, tstockdetail.origin_id, tstockdetail.origin_code, tstockdetail.status, tstockdetail.create_by,tstockdetail.batch_code, tstockdetail.create_time, tstockdetail.update_by, tstockdetail.update_time, tstockdetail.remark, tstockdetail.dept_id, tstockdetail.dept_name, tstockdetail.del_flag,tm.name as materialName,tu.name as unitName,tm.specifications,tm.code as materialCode from t_stock_detail tstockdetail
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = tstockdetail.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
LEFT JOIN t_material tm on tm.id=tstockdetail.material_id LEFT JOIN t_unit tu on tu.id=tm.unit_id
tstockdetail.del_flag = '0'
and tstockdetail.material_id in
#{materialId}
and tstockdetail.batch_code like concat('%', #{batchCode}, '%') and tm.code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%') and tm.name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by tstockdetail.create_time desc

select m.code materialCode, m.name materialName, un.name unitName, sd.batch_code batchCode, sd.type, ABS(sd.current_count-sd.before_count) count, sd.create_time createTime, round(ABS(timestampdiff(second,sd.create_time,case sd.type when 1 then ad.create_time else od.create_time end))/3600,1) timeConsume from t_stock_detail sd
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = tstockdetail.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
LEFT JOIN t_material m on m.id=sd.material_id LEFT JOIN t_unit un on un.id=m.unit_id LEFT JOIN t_contacts_unit cu on cu.id=m.contacts_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_advance_delivery ad on ad.code=sd.origin_code LEFT JOIN t_out_delivery od on od.code=sd.origin_code where sd.del_flag = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' and sd.type in('1','2') and sd.origin_code is not null and m.code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%') and m.name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%') and sd.batch_code like concat('%', #{batchCode}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by sd.create_time desc

select m.code materialCode, m.name materialName, un.name unitName, sd.batch_code batchCode, sd.type, ABS(sd.current_count-sd.before_count) count, sd.create_time createTime, round(ABS(timestampdiff(second,sd.create_time,case sd.type when 1 then ad.create_time else od.create_time end))/3600,1) timeConsume from t_stock_detail sd
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = tstockdetail.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
LEFT JOIN t_material m on m.id=sd.material_id LEFT JOIN t_unit un on un.id=m.unit_id LEFT JOIN t_contacts_unit cu on cu.id=m.contacts_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_advance_delivery ad on ad.code=sd.origin_code LEFT JOIN t_out_delivery od on od.code=sd.origin_code where sd.del_flag = '0' and sd.type in('1','2') and sd.origin_code is not null and m.code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%') and m.name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%') and sd.batch_code like concat('%', #{batchCode}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by sd.create_time desc

select date_format(s.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime, m.code materialCode, m.name materialName, m.specifications, un.name unitName, sum(current_count-before_count) changeCount from t_stock_detail s left join t_material m on m.id=s.material_id left join t_unit un on un.id=m.unit_id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = s.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
where s.del_flag = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%')
and s.create_time>=#{beginDate}
and #{endDate}>=s.create_time
${params.dataScope} group by m.id,createTime order by createTime desc,m.id desc

select sd.batch_code batchCode, sd.type, sd.current_count-sd.before_count changeCount, sd.before_count beforeCount, sd.current_count currentCount, sd.create_time createTime, m.code materialCode, m.name materialName, m.specifications, un.name unitName, tl.name as locationName from t_stock_detail sd LEFT JOIN t_material m on m.id=sd.material_id LEFT JOIN t_unit un on un.id = m.unit_id LEFT JOIN t_location tl on sd.location_id = tl.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = sd.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
where sd.del_flag = '0' and m.del_flag='0' and m.code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%') and m.name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%') and sd.batch_code like concat('%', #{batchCode}, '%') and tl.name like concat('%', #{locationName}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by sd.id desc

select ifnull(sum((t1.current_count - t1.before_count) * t2.unit_price), 0) as count, date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month from t_stock_detail t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.type = '1' and YEAR(t1.create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) group by date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m')

select ifnull(sum((t1.before_count - t1.current_count) * t2.unit_price), 0) as count, date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month from t_stock_detail t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.type = '2' and YEAR(t1.create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) group by date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m')
